review_method: git show, git diff and git grep against immutable commit objects; mutable working-tree files were not used as review source.

actionable_findings.priority: P2 conditional on a custom mount configuration
actionable_findings.title: Bind the adopted early Knowledge response to the mounted API URL
actionable_findings.trigger: A caller supplies both options.apiBase for a different endpoint and the early knowledgeOpening object while the fragment still matches.
actionable_findings.behavior: request('/knowledge') adopts opening.response without comparing endpoint identity. A valid representation from the early same-origin endpoint can render as the mounted endpoint's fresh Knowledge and persist under that alternate apiIdentity.
evidence: casepath/assets/autonomous-entry-v1.js:20-24 fetches the fixed same-origin Knowledge path and records fragment/controller/timeout/response, without an API URL.
casepath/assets/autonomous-workspace-v1.js:2056 supports options.apiBase; :2070 derives cache apiIdentity from that base.
casepath/assets/autonomous-workspace-v1.js:2260-2267 adopts by readonly path and fragment only, bypassing fetcher(base + path).
casepath/assets/autonomous-workspace-v1.js:3950-3951 admits the validated response to Knowledge caches; :2176 labels persisted material with apiIdentity.
actionable_findings.reachability_qualification: The shipped entry calls mount without apiBase, so fixed early URL and default BASE match. No in-tree custom apiBase caller was found in the immutable scope search; this is an exported mount-option compatibility gap, not a demonstrated hosted-path failure. root.CASEPATH_API does not control this workspace: BASE is the fixed path at workspace line 10.
actionable_findings.recommended_narrow_change: Record the early request's absolute URL, compare it with the resolved mounted base + '/knowledge' before adoption, and discard the opening if the URL differs or cannot be resolved. Preserve the normal fetch path on mismatch.
actionable_findings.recommended_regression: Use a mismatched options.apiBase plus a valid early response; assert the early response is discarded/aborted and the configured API receives the Knowledge GET. Keep same-API adoption and normal validation coverage.

other_review_conclusions.conclusion: Initial routeChanged runs after mount registration; a fragment different from the early request's fragment discards and aborts the unused opening before selecting the current view.

Adopted data passes the existing HTTP status/JSON path and readKnowledge validation. showKnowledge retains epoch, read counter, generation and pending-route checks; no new stale completion repaint path was found. The response is the complete Knowledge projection rather than a pin-specific API request.

The 15-second abort deadline starts at the early fetch, is reused rather than reset on adoption, and is cleared by normal request cleanup. Script-load failure aborts the unused opening. Destroy discards an unused opening and aborts adopted controllers through the existing controller set.

Persistence yields through requestAnimationFrame then a timer before serialization. Disposed/generation/write checks run after the yield and after asynchronous hashing. In a hidden document, requestAnimationFrame may pause optional persistence; fresh read validation and rendering do not await this cache write. No correctness finding was identified in this change.

validation.new_tests_inspected: The added tests cover early overlap, public/route specificity, load-failure cancellation, normal validation/retry, unused-route discard, late response ownership, paint-before-cache and destroy-before-cache. They do not cover API URL mismatch.
